D: A company of Australian and New Zealand soldiers fight outnumbered in a rubber plantation in Vietnam.
P: Serve the main after the concert at Nui Dat.
S: Salted peanuts and crackers with cheese, the snacks around the base before the concert. Tip 200g salted peanuts into a bowl and arrange 200g crackers with 150g sliced cheddar on a board.
Fresh rice paper rolls with prawns, noodles and mint, with a dipping sauce. Soak 100g vermicelli.
M: Beef and bean stew with tomatoes, hearty field food. Brown 800g diced chuck with a chopped onion.
W: the chocolate in the ration packs
Dark chocolate squares with fresh orange segments. Break 200g dark chocolate into squares and serve with 3 peeled oranges cut into segments.
K: back at base after the battle
Cold lager, lemonade for anyone not drinking. Chill 8 cans lager and serve in cold glasses.

s.how: Tip 200g salted peanuts into a bowl and arrange 200g crackers with 150g sliced cheddar on a board. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.
Soak 100g vermicelli. Dip 12 rice paper sheets in warm water and fill with prawns, noodles, lettuce and mint. Roll tight and serve with hoisin and peanut sauce.

m.how: Brown 800g diced chuck with a chopped onion. Add 400g diced tomatoes, 800g drained kidney beans and 500ml stock and simmer 2 hours. Serve with bread.

w.note: the chocolate in the ration packs
w.how: Break 200g dark chocolate into squares and serve with 3 peeled oranges cut into segments. Serve it at the halfway point of the film. Leave it out for anyone who wants seconds.

d.note: back at base after the battle
d.how: Chill 8 cans lager and serve in cold glasses. Have 1.25L lemonade over ice for anyone not drinking. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
